findings.text: To provide 'missing batteries' that allow users to maximize the use of a functional programming style within Python, despite Python not being a pure-functional language.
Provides functional programming utilities like mapping and filtering (e.g., `map(_ * 2, range(5))`).
Implements advanced functional operations such as `zipwith` (combining multiple iterables element-wise).

evidence.quote: Vector: O(log32(n)) access to elements by index (which is near-O(1) for reasonable vector size), implementation is based on BitmappedTrie, almost drop-in replacement for built-in Python list

findings.text: Offers persistent data structures (e.g., `fn.immutable.Vector`) that provide immutable versions of collections and efficient structural sharing.
Supports function composition and partial application using overloaded operators (`<<` for left-to-right composition, `>>` for right-to-left composition).
Functional operations (like `map` and `filter`) utilize utilities from the `fn.op` module.
Iterator utilities in `fn/iters.py` depend on the function composition capabilities provided by `fn.func.F`.

evidence.quote: ``_`` will fail with ``ArityError`` (``TypeError`` subclass) on inaccurate number of passed arguments.

findings.text: The `fn._` lambda variable enforces correct function arity when used in expressions, raising an `ArityError` otherwise.
The project is hosted on GitHub at `https://github.com/kachayev/fn.py`.
Example usage and test cases are available online at `https://github.com/kachayev/fn.py/blob/master/tests.py`.
